raw_result: {"facts": [{"item_id": "22b0115523b64f31b4befe00df9ba5f2::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Thesauri that are proprietary and not universally accessible should be avoided wherever possible."}, {"item_id": "6bc14ed456bd49ffaad20458c905d575::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Agencies must not embed static, unchanging third-party web assets hosted on services not under the agency's control."}, {"item_id": "0178996cb3d2412aabf131da3ff621b2::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Each important URL should be reachable through crawlable internal links."}, {"item_id": "42c0370815994c68b0fad09f18497cdb::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Agencies' public-facing websites must contain a search function."}, {"item_id": "42c0370815994c68b0fad09f18497cdb::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Agencies should participate in the Search.gov program."}, {"item_id": "bbcb5520096f4019950adf4c6e284c0a::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Normalized representations should be preferred."}, {"item_id": "bbcb5520096f4019950adf4c6e284c0a::text", "attribute": "text", "fact_text": "Normalized representations are generally easier to query and combine."}]}
